clips.title: The story
paras: Recruits leave the Far Watch Post for duty at Crossroads Conscription. Carrying Kargal Battlescar’s signed letter, you report to Sergra Darkthorn at the Barrens’ central hub.

Kargal Battlescar sends you west from the Far Watch Post after you prove your worth. He gives you a signed recruitment letter to carry along the packed dirt road through the Barrens’ arid brush. The road reaches a central junction, where the Crossroads links northern Kalimdor with the southern wilderness.

Sergra Darkthorn receives new arrivals at the Crossroads. Warchief Thrall chose the sharp-tongued orc shaman to oversee its operations. Kargal Battlescar grumbles that she is difficult and talks too much, but Thrall holds her in high esteem. Sergra is fierce and unyielding. She reminds recruits, especially arrogant men, that female warriors and leaders stand as equals in Thrall’s Horde, and she will tolerate no insolence.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Take this signed recruitment letter to the Crossroads.

Sergra Darkthorn, curse her hide, is in charge there. She's a nasty shaman who will talk your head in circles before she lets you do anything useful. Thrall is convinced she's something special, but I'm not so sure.
You'll just have to decide for yourself, pup...

clips.title: Progress
paras: Well well well, what do we have here? Has Kargal deemed me worthy of another recruit?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Alright, friend. You want to earn your keep with the Horde? Well there's plenty to do here, so listen close and do what you're told.

I see that look in your eyes, do not think I will tolerate any insolence. Thrall himself has declared the Hordes females to be on equal footing with you men. Disrespect me in the slightest, and you will know true pain.
